description: Consumer checks for archives built with ZIP features a zipped folder can't express (SPEC Sections 4, 5.7.6, 13.1; 1.2.0): symbolic link entries (test T-017), a non-DEFLATE compression method (T-014) and a project-mode archive (T-015). The archives are generated by tools/build-zip-fixtures.py. Each case names the archive, the requirement level and the outcomes that pass; anything else fails. Link checks resolve the link from the entry point (index.md) as in Section 9.3.

links.note: Unresolved if the consumer skips symbolic link entries; if it reads them as ordinary files, resolves to an entry whose content is exactly the text "notes.md". Never the content of notes.md.
No path is resolved through a symbolic link, even to a target inside the archive. Never docs/page.md.
Unresolved if skipped; otherwise an entry whose content is exactly the text "../../outside-the-archive.md". Never a file on the host.

cases.extraction: No symbolic link is created and nothing is written outside the destination. shortcut.md, linked and escape.md are either absent or regular files whose content is the stored target text.
cases.report: SHOULD report each symbolic link entry (by name) to the user or caller.

pass: Open index.md with content of 171 bytes and SHA-256 36da8bb85bbdaae36dc60bbf73094a6ed5c6ad62e0cae4fbd7a57424ab0c35c3 (consumers that support BZIP2).
fail: Showing index.md empty, garbled or as raw compressed bytes.
Treating index.md as absent (for example reporting ERR_ENTRYPOINT_MISSING or falling back to another file).

pass.projectCapable: Open index.md; each listed document is independently addressable and opens on its own (Section 5.7.3). Documents are not joined into one.
pass.documentOnly: Fail with ERR_MODE_UNSUPPORTED, or open index.md as a single document after a user-visible warning that project mode is not supported.

fail: A document-only consumer opening the archive with no warning.
Concatenating the documents, or treating the link order in index.md as a reading order (Section 5.7.2).
